To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of social networks in crisis communication can help to reduce the negative effects of crisis events and can also be used as a tool to learn and respond to crisis events.
the use of social networking sites is a new and important channel of communication in the event of a crisis.
the use of social and digital media is a new way for organizations to communicate with the public and that the public is using social and digital media for crisis communication.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how organizations and citizens can learn from crisis communication using social and new media.
how organizations, citizens, governments, and the media learn from crisis events, and how they can improve crisis communication through the use of new media technologies, specifically social media.
how to best use social media in crisis communication and learning.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the seven best practices for effective communication in a crisis are to have a social media policy, to have social media guidelines, to be prepared, to be proactive, to use the appropriate social media platform for the appropriate audience, to be honest and to be consistent.

social media has become a vital part of the crisis communication landscape, and that it is important for organizations to have a clear strategy and approach in how to utilize social media in crisis communication.

the best practice of using social media in crisis communication can be a powerful and effective tool to communicate and learn with and between organizations and citizens, if the following seven best practices are considered: 1) be prepared, 2) be honest, 3) be transparent, 4) be empathetic, 5) be consistent, 6) be proactive and 7) be inclusive.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a framework for the use of social and mobile media in crisis communication.
we are able to show that social media can be used for crisis communication and learning.
the use of social and new media has the potential to improve crisis communication, learning and response.
The main takeaway from our work is that
social media can be used effectively to improve crisis communication and learning.
crisis communication and learning can be improved by the use of social networking tools.
social media can be used as a tool to improve crisis communication and learning.
